--- file:///.src/matchToResultOrOption_references.ts ---
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics matchToResultOrOption:warning
import { Effect, Exit, Option, Result } from "effect"
import * as R from "effect/Result"
import { fail as resultFail, succeed as resultSucceed } from "effect/Result"

declare const source: Effect.Effect<number, string>

const Local = { Result: { succeed: <A>(a: A) => a, fail: <E>(e: E) => e } }
const succeedAlias = Result.succeed

// MUST TRIGGER: Result constructors through the effect/Result subpath namespace
export const subpath = Effect.result(source)

// MUST TRIGGER: renamed named imports of the Result constructors
export const named = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: resultFail, onSuccess: resultSucceed })

// MUST TRIGGER: local constant alias of Result.succeed
export const alias = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Result.fail, onSuccess: succeedAlias })

// MUST TRIGGER: the fold is a data-first argument of another call, so it roots its own flow
export const nestedArgument = Effect.andThen(
  Effect.log("start"),
  Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Result.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed })
)

// MUST TRIGGER: map + catch pair inside a longer flow; the fix keeps the other steps
export const pairInLongerFlow = source.pipe(
  Effect.tap((n) => Effect.log(n)),
  Effect.map(Option.some),
  Effect.catch(() => Effect.succeed(Option.none())),
  Effect.map(Option.isSome)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a local object with Result-shaped members is not the Result module
export const lookalike = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Local.Result.fail, onSuccess: Local.Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Effect.fail is not Result.fail
export const effectFail = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Exit.fail is not Result.fail
export const exitFail = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Exit.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a generic handler is not an identity forwarder
export const genericHandler = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: <E>(e: E) => Result.fail(e), onSuccess: Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Option.none on success discards the value
export const noneOnSuccess = Effect.matchEffect(source, {
  onFailure: () => Effect.succeed(Option.none()),
  onSuccess: () => Effect.succeed(Option.none())
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: extra spread properties next to the handlers
export const extraSpread = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Result.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed, ...{} })

// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics matchToResultOrOption:warning
import { Effect, Exit, Option, Result } from "effect"
import * as R from "effect/Result"
import { fail as resultFail, succeed as resultSucceed } from "effect/Result"

declare const source: Effect.Effect<number, string>

const Local = { Result: { succeed: <A>(a: A) => a, fail: <E>(e: E) => e } }
const succeedAlias = Result.succeed

export const subpath = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: R.fail, onSuccess: R.succeed })

// MUST TRIGGER: renamed named imports of the Result constructors
export const named = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: resultFail, onSuccess: resultSucceed })

// MUST TRIGGER: local constant alias of Result.succeed
export const alias = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Result.fail, onSuccess: succeedAlias })

// MUST TRIGGER: the fold is a data-first argument of another call, so it roots its own flow
export const nestedArgument = Effect.andThen(
  Effect.log("start"),
  Effect.result(source)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: map + catch pair inside a longer flow; the fix keeps the other steps
export const pairInLongerFlow = source.pipe(
  Effect.tap((n) => Effect.log(n)),
  Effect.map(Option.some),
  Effect.catch(() => Effect.succeed(Option.none())),
  Effect.map(Option.isSome)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a local object with Result-shaped members is not the Result module

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Effect.fail is not Result.fail
export const effectFail = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Exit.fail is not Result.fail
export const exitFail = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Exit.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a generic handler is not an identity forwarder

--- file:///.src/matchToResultOrOption_references.ts ---
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics matchToResultOrOption:warning
import { Effect, Exit, Option, Result } from "effect"
import * as R from "effect/Result"
import { fail as resultFail, succeed as resultSucceed } from "effect/Result"

declare const source: Effect.Effect<number, string>

const Local = { Result: { succeed: <A>(a: A) => a, fail: <E>(e: E) => e } }
const succeedAlias = Result.succeed

// MUST TRIGGER: Result constructors through the effect/Result subpath namespace
export const subpath = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: R.fail, onSuccess: R.succeed })

// MUST TRIGGER: renamed named imports of the Result constructors
export const named = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: resultFail, onSuccess: resultSucceed })

// MUST TRIGGER: local constant alias of Result.succeed
export const alias = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Result.fail, onSuccess: succeedAlias })

// MUST TRIGGER: the fold is a data-first argument of another call, so it roots its own flow
export const nestedArgument = Effect.andThen(
  Effect.log("start"),
  Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Result.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed })
)

// MUST TRIGGER: map + catch pair inside a longer flow; the fix keeps the other steps
export const pairInLongerFlow = source.pipe(Effect.tap(n => Effect.log(n)), Effect.option, Effect.map(Option.isSome))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a local object with Result-shaped members is not the Result module
export const lookalike = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Local.Result.fail, onSuccess: Local.Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Effect.fail is not Result.fail
export const effectFail = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Exit.fail is not Result.fail
export const exitFail = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Exit.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a generic handler is not an identity forwarder
export const genericHandler = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: <E>(e: E) => Result.fail(e), onSuccess: Result.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Option.none on success discards the value
export const noneOnSuccess = Effect.matchEffect(source, {
  onFailure: () => Effect.succeed(Option.none()),
  onSuccess: () => Effect.succeed(Option.none())
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: extra spread properties next to the handlers
export const extraSpread = Effect.match(source, { onFailure: Result.fail, onSuccess: Result.succeed, ...{} })
